items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: Yeah when I walked out of the studio I says, “How was that Neil?” He says, “Well I didn’t hear anything wrong with it.”

ctx.x: I believe I read that Neil Diamond gave you a sort of a wishy-washy compliment on your work for “Sweet Caroline.”
Yeah when I walked out of the studio I says, “How was that Neil?” He says, “Well I didn’t hear anything wrong with it.”

“Well can I have a raise on that?” I had a fascinating chat with Bucky Pizzarelli once about, you know all the studio work he did. Because I noticed sometimes there’d be upwards of three or more guitars. And he said the guys sort of had worked out, you know one’s going to do [scats] and one’s going to play big chords and the other is little lines. Did you like to see particular players in the studio that knew that kind of thing?
